editorial: This report contains trends that have emerged for the first time today, without repeating records included in normal reports from the last 30 days.

items.title: tt-a1i/archify
items.summary: Archify is an AI agent skill that creates verifiable and interactive HTML files for architectural, data flow, and workflow diagrams. Used to visualize complex system designs, this tool supports high-resolution export of diagrams.

items.title: ConardLi/garden-skills
items.summary: garden-skills, developed by ConardLi, is an open-source collection that offers ready-to-use skill packages in various fields such as web design, information retrieval, and visual generation. This modular structure, which developers can integrate into their projects, allows for the centralized use of different functions.

items.title: browser-use/browser-use
items.summary: Browser-use is a Python library that enables AI agents to interact with websites just like humans. It allows for the automation of complex tasks on the internet through browser-based operations.

items.title: K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills
items.summary: Scientific-agent-skills is a library of ready-to-use skills that adapts AI agents to scientific research processes. It offers 163 verified skills and over 100 databases in the fields of biology, chemistry, and medicine, and works integrated with platforms such as the code editor Cursor or the AI assistant Claude Code.

items.title: AWS Acquires DuckDB
items.summary: Amazon Web Services (AWS) has acquired DuckLabs, the developer of the analytical database management system DuckDB. With this acquisition, the cloud computing giant AWS aims to integrate data processing and querying technologies into its own infrastructure.

items.title: GLM-5.3-Flash
items.summary: GLM-5.3-Flash, developed by Zhipu AI, is a large language model focused on low latency and high efficiency. The model provides performance improvements by optimizing hardware resources, especially in applications requiring fast responses.

items.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next: A New Architecture, Towards Ultimate Cost-Efficiency
items.summary: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, a large language model (LLM) developed by Alibaba, focuses on reducing processing costs with a new architectural design. The model aims to increase resource efficiency in high-performance inference processes.

items.title: Z.ai confirms Ox Alpha is a new GLM-series model and will release its weights
items.summary: Z.ai has announced the Ox Alpha model, part of its new generation general language model series. The company stated that it will share the weights of this model, which is positioned as a competitor to large AI models like DeepSeek, as open source.

items.title: RAG Is Simpler Than You Think
items.summary: The retrieval-augmented generation process, which connects retrieved data to AI models, also yields successful results with simple data processing methods instead of complex architectures. This approach argues that large language models should be stripped of unnecessary technical layers when using external data.

items.title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
items.summary: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, developed by Alibaba, is a multimodal AI model capable of processing visual and text data. Optimized to produce fast responses with low latency, this model analyzes visual content to generate text-based outputs.

items.title: zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash
items.summary: Developed by Zai-org, GLM-5.3-Flash is an artificial intelligence model focused on text generation. Optimized to produce fast responses with low latency, this model aims to increase efficiency in text-based tasks.

items.title: Autonomous Mathematical Discovery in an Open-World Multi-Agent Environment
items.summary: The open-world environment called Station allows different artificial intelligence models to make collaborative mathematical discoveries without a central administrator. Agents determine their own research processes and conduct experiments, collaborating to reach previously unknown mathematical results.

items.title: SecOPD: Mitigating Adaptive Prompt Injections by On-Policy Distillation
items.summary: SecOPD is an on-policy distillation method developed to prevent prompt injection attacks against artificial intelligence agents. This approach aims to increase model security against adaptive attacks by addressing weaknesses in existing defensive fine-tuning processes.

items.title: AgentRoom: Concurrent Multi-Agent Coding in a CRDT-Backed Shared Workspace
items.summary: AgentRoom provides a workspace that allows multiple artificial intelligence agents to write code simultaneously in software development processes. Using Conflict-free Replicated Data Types (CRDT) technology, the system ensures that agents maintain data consistency while working concurrently.

items.title: Automata from Agent Traces: Failure and Next-Step Prediction
items.summary: A new method has been developed that analyzes the complex workflows of large language model-based agents by converting all processes into a single finite-state machine. This approach aims to standardize error prediction and runtime monitoring processes by making the behavioral structure of the agents visible.

items.title: GigaBrain-0.7: Scaling Embodied Foundation Models to Emergent Capabilities with a Three-System Architecture
items.summary: GigaBrain-0.7 is a vision-language-action model developed for robotic systems capable of moving in the physical world. Thanks to its three-system architecture, it aims to enable robots to perform complex tasks in a wider environment by processing different datasets.

items.title: The Move to Python 3 Begins
items.summary: EVE Online developers have initiated the process of migrating the game's infrastructure from the long-used Python 2 version to the current Python 3 version. This transition aims to reduce the game's technical debt and increase compatibility with modern software libraries.

items.title: Casey Muratori – The Root of The Root of All Evil – BSC 2026
items.summary: Software developer Casey Muratori criticizes layered abstraction approaches that increase complexity in modern software development processes. He analyzes how these architectural choices, which lead to performance and efficiency losses, deepen the technical debt at the foundation of software.

items.title: I stabilized never type
items.summary: The 'never' type examines the concept of a bottom type used in programming languages for functions that return no value. This approach allows the compiler to detect unreachable parts of the code, thereby improving the debugging process.

glossary.explanation: Special capabilities used by artificial intelligence-powered software to perform a specific task.
The technical skills that a software or artificial intelligence possesses to successfully complete a specific operation.
Comprehensive artificial intelligence models trained on very large datasets that can form a foundation in many different fields.
A massive cloud platform where you can rent computing services such as servers, storage, and databases over the internet.
Artificial intelligence models trained on very large data that can understand human language and generate text.
The abbreviation for large-scale artificial intelligence language models that can process human language and generate meaningful responses.
The process of a trained artificial intelligence model making predictions or generating results when it encounters data it has not seen before.
